title: Singaporeans Employed in Financial Services Sector
what_it_is: Singaporeans Employed in Financial Services Sector

sections.label: Financial sector employment and nationalities
sections.summary: Financial sector jobs grew from 149,000 in 2014 to 171,000 in 2019, with Singaporeans at 70% of the workforce and 44% of senior roles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Total employment in the sector grew from 149,000 in 2014 to 171,000 in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: So, about 22,000 financial sector jobs were created over the past five years, with 15,000 going to Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Based on MAS' estimates, about 70% of the workforce are Singaporeans, 14% Permanent Residents or PRs, and 16% foreigners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: If we zoom in on senior roles, Singaporeans account for 44%, PRs 20% and foreigners 36%.

sections.label: Singaporeans moving into senior roles
sections.summary: More Singaporeans moved up to senior roles and took senior roles overseas, which the passage attributes to bringing in expertise and investing in local expertise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As a result, the absolute number of Singaporeans that moved up to senior roles have increased.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: They are now also going out, taking up senior roles overseas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We are able to do all this only because we continued to bring in expertise; at the same time, work with financial institutions, invest in our local expertise, grow our own timber.

sections.label: Openness and investing in people
sections.summary: The passage states that being open to the world, working with financial institutions and investing in people can let middle management move up to senior positions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Be open to the world, make ourselves that global financial centre, work with the financial institutions, invest in our people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Then, I think middle management can move up to take up senior positions.
